asset_one_owner.name: asset_one_owner
asset_one_owner.value: ("asset"."project_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("asset"."document_id" IS NOT NULL)

document_scope_parent.name: document_scope_parent
document_scope_parent.value:
CASE "document"."scope"
        WHEN 'team' THEN "document"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("document"."work_project_id", "document"."task_id") = 0
        WHEN 'project' THEN "document"."work_project_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("document"."project_id", "document"."task_id") = 0
        WHEN 'issue' THEN "document"."task_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("document"."project_id", "document"."work_project_id") = 0
        WHEN 'private' THEN num_nonnulls("document"."project_id", "document"."work_project_id", "document"."task_id") = 0
        WHEN 'workspace' THEN num_nonnulls("document"."project_id", "document"."work_project_id", "document"."task_id") = 0
        ELSE false END

task_project_scheduled_id_idx.name: task_project_scheduled_id_idx
task_project_scheduled_id_idx.where: "task"."start_date" is not null or "task"."due_date" is not null

topic_scope_parent.name: topic_scope_parent
topic_scope_parent.value:
CASE "topic"."scope"
        WHEN 'team' THEN "topic"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "topic"."work_project_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'project' THEN "topic"."work_project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "topic"."project_id" IS NULL
        WHEN 'workspace' THEN num_nonnulls("topic"."project_id", "topic"."work_project_id") = 0
        ELSE false END
